newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TEJ SAYS IN TALKS AFTER SHARE PRICE RISE.
newsitem.headline: TEJ SAYS IN TALKS AFTER SHARE PRICE RISE.

text.p: Clothing company Towles, Edgar Jacobs Ltd (TEJ) said on Wednesday it was in talks which could have an impact on its share price and urged shareholders to exercise caution in their dealings.

It gave no further details in a brief announcement which follows a sharp rise in the company's share price in recent days on talk of further acquisitions. The tightly-held share closed at a new year high of 19.00 rand on Tuesday.
